{{Quote|A year ago next week, he was setting up a base on Aargonar when clones attacked. My husband fought bravely in self-defense&hellip;but was killed.|Mina Bonteri|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
A '''battle on Aargonar'''<ref name="Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> was fought when [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] attacked a new [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Aargonar Separatist base/Legends|base]]. An [[Mina Bonteri's husband/Legends|officer]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], who was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]], was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />
